svg.text: For design understanding and early scope coordination only.
Detailed fixing, connection, and installation information is excluded.

foreignObject.div: The roofline cornice provides the principal architectural termination at the building top, creating a pronounced horizontal expression and clean visual boundary between facade and sky.
The parapet edge profile caps the building crown with a crisp, molded GRC/GFRC detail that provides weather protection and visual refinement at the uppermost boundary.
Intermediate horizontal profiles — string courses, band courses, and sill lines — divide the facade vertically and create layered shadow expression at key floor transitions.
Each cornice profile is composed of classical molding members — fillets, cymas, coronas, and bed molds — that are produced as GRC/GFRC panels to any project drawing or profile specification.

svg.text: Roofline Cornice — primary facade crown element
Parapet Edge Profile — top edge detail and capping
Horizontal Facade Transition — string course banding
Shadow Line Expression — depth and visual contrast
Decorative Profile Shape — molding member composition
Finish / Surface Texture — per project specification
DURRAKA FACTORY FOR INDUSTRY — GRC/GFRC MANUFACTURING
